MyEdu – 3D virtual science lab, MCQ practice and school management

MyEdu is a platform for schools, tuition classes, teachers, students and parents. It works in English, Hindi and Gujarati.

What MyEdu offers

  • A 3D Science Lab with 101 interactive Physics, Chemistry and Biology experiments and models for Class 10, 11 and 12
  • MCQ practice for JEE, NEET and GUJCET
  • Study PDFs and notes
  • Attendance and announcements, with separate logins for principals, teachers, students and parents
